prompt:
SUMMARY: hairstyle a high braided crown with a long straight tail draped down her back; costume silhouette a fitted base layer with flowing panels of projected light floating around her like a gown — a silhouette spread in light; design idea The gown's floating layers are supported by concentric frames with stepped shoulders and a clear central aperture, echoing the Pantheon's load-bearing coffers and open oculus.; face gently long oval face, pale violet eyes; expression a small closed-lip smile.
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Italian woman — the personification of the city of Rome — one woman who IS Rome as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: an elegant, refined presence; olive skin; gently long oval face; soft almond eyes with gently lowered outer corners; pale violet eyes; gently arched, slender brows; a nose with a gentle aquiline curve; lips with a defined cupid's bow, of natural size.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: willowy and long-limbed with soft curves — a full bust, rounded hips and a slender waist build; a high braided crown with a long straight tail draped down her back; deep wine-red hair.
Expression: a small closed-lip smile that reaches the eyes.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — CYBERPUNK
Costume: far-future techwear cut to the outfit silhouette below — smart fabric, chrome and glossy vinyl, fine straps and glowing light lines, glowing tattoo lines and cybernetic implants on her skin, holographic jewelry; sign light reflected on her face.
City motif: a wrap of travertine-white smart fabric draped over one shoulder like an ancient toga, its surface drifting with rings of soft gold light squares in the coffered pattern of the old domed temple, converging on an open ring of light at her breast like its oculus; a slim circlet of glowing gold laurel leaves in her hair.
World marks on her: glowing neon tattoos; cybernetic implants; reflective trim catching the light; sign light reflected on her face; holographic jewelry; fiber-optic glowing hair strands; chrome and glossy vinyl; magenta and cyan glow; soft holographic light shimmering across her skin and clothes; techwear traced with glowing light lines; far-future smart fabric rippling with soft light patterns.
Silhouette: a fitted base layer with flowing panels of projected light floating around her like a gown — a silhouette spread in light. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Design idea: The gown's floating layers are supported by concentric frames with stepped shoulders and a clear central aperture, echoing the Pantheon's load-bearing coffers and open oculus.
Colours: travertine cream, terracotta, imperial gold — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a small golden orb projecting a holographic map of glowing roads that all converge on the seven hills; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her techwear opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and midriff or a deep neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs, traced with glowing tattoo lines. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: Rome two centuries from now, a far-future megacity: the seven hills grown into terraced arcology hills topped with gardens of light; the ancient ring-shaped amphitheatre kept whole as a heritage ruin beneath a floating canopy of light, now a sky-stage; the old domed temple's open eye turned into a beacon sending a pillar of light into the night sky; maglev lines of light gliding along the arches of the old aqueducts across the hills; and in the old forum a golden milestone from which every glowing route of the city radiates outward, the fountains running with luminous aquamarine water under a clear violet night sky.
This card: on the glass plaza over the old forum around the golden milestone, glowing routes of light radiating out from it across the ground in every direction and the columns of the ancient ruins standing softly lit among the towers.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: She holds the orb at waist height with one palm up, the free arm lowered and visibly separated from the gown.
Setting detail: The golden routes bend into concentric rings across the glass where they meet the milestone.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
